dominance_ratio.label: Bimanual symmetry (dominance ratio)
dominance_ratio.note: lower = more two-handed symmetry; elite ~1.4 vs a casual top-3% solver ~2.25

fatigue_decline_pct.label: Fatigue resistance (pace change start to end)
fatigue_decline_pct.note: less negative = holds pace better through the session; elite around -36%

combined_grips_per_min.label: Combined grip pace (grips/min)
combined_grips_per_min.note: recorded casually; her competition ceiling is ~40. Loose reference only.

parallel_active_pct.label: Parallel-active (both hands working at once)
parallel_active_pct.note: REVERSED in the data vs a top-3% solver; not a reliable elite marker

mean_grip_hold_s.label: Mean grip hold (s)
mean_grip_hold_s.note: almost certainly an analyzer artifact on her footage; do not trust
